claim: A smooth phase-blind positive real response to the complex separating coordinate epsilon has leading dependence |epsilon|^2 and therefore loses the linear oriented chi5 seam; retaining the seam requires two quadratures or a selected phase reference.
noGo: No smooth real scalar can be phase invariant, sign changing with a linear zero, and vanish only at the codimension-two separating point.
minimalEnrichments: two coherent quadratures forming a complex response
an independently sourced phase reference selecting one real normal
detectorRule: Power detects the squared seam; interference is required to retain its orientation.
